# unraid_settings (Data Source)

Unified API settings (API origins, sandbox, SSO/OIDC, ...) as a JSON document. Marked sensitive because it can contain OIDC client secrets. Use `jsondecode()` to access values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_settings" "this" {}

locals {
  settings = jsondecode(data.unraid_settings.this.values_json)
}

output "api_sandbox_enabled" {
  value = nonsensitive(try(local.settings.api.sandbox, null))
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Settings identifier.
- `values_json` (String, Sensitive) Current settings values as a JSON string.
